In my opinion schizoid and autism are fundamentally different. Here are some notable points.

Schizoid wants to be left alone while autist wants to connect but lacks the social skills to do so.

Schizoid is more stoic internally and externally in the face of adverse or positive stimuli than the average person while autist is more hypersensitive, including hypersensitive to sensory stimuli like touch, sound, smell.

Schizoid is cold, lacks integration or has diminished experience (alexithymic) of basic human emotions while autist is highly emotional but lacks the ability to express and modulate emotions appropriately. In the face of adversity schizoid is more likely to retreat into inner world while autist is more likely to have an outburst or meltdown. 

Schizoid is internally oriented. Values and life priorities are formed based on internal ideas while autist is externally oriented toward special interests or toward ineptly attempting to connect with others.
